subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: When the docgate gate runs, the structure arm shall parse the authority-contract file (version-pinned) and report a named defect when its current-tier does not name a tier declared in the ladder, or when the latest change-history row's tier does not equal the current tier (a bare pointer flip).
rationale: DINV-4 tier-in-ladder + no bare pointer flip (J2)
fit_criterion: on the seeded fixtures (current-tier not in ladder; latest-history-tier ≠ current-tier), the arm reports a defect naming the file and the invariant; a legal contract passes
